listing.tagline: Fishing supplies in Douala, delivered or picked up, paid by cash or mobile money.
listing.description: Tide & Tackle is the Shipvo sample shop: a catalogue of lures, rods and line, a cart with promo codes, delivery slots or shop pickup, barcode scanning, distance from the shop by location, and payment by cash on delivery or mobile money confirmed with a fingerprint and PIN. Every release ships to real Android phones over the air and to this simulator; the three purchase flows are measured against real devices nightly.
